Pharmacopoeias. In Chin., Eur. (see p.vii), Jpn, and US. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Triamcinolone). A white or almost white, crystal- line powder. It shows polymorphism. Practically insoluble in wa- ter and in dichloromethane; slightly soluble in methyl alcohol. Protect from light. USP 31 (Triamcinolone). A white or practically white, odour- less, crystalline powder. Very slightly soluble in water, in chloro- form, and in ether; slightly soluble in alcohol and in methyl alco- hol.
